bus.via: Chicago Bus Station to Milwaukee Intermodal Station

trips.route_note: Take an Amtrak Hiawatha train from Chicago Union Station to Milwaukee Intermodal Station, about 1.5 hours direct, then walk or take a short local bus or rideshare to the lakefront museums.
see: Milwaukee Art Museum and its lakefront Calatrava wing
Historic Third Ward shops and restaurants
Brewery tour at Pabst Mansion or a local brewery
trips.why: The Amtrak Hiawatha is the fastest option at about 1h 29m and drops you at Milwaukee Intermodal Station, a short ride from the lakefront museums.
know: Book Amtrak ahead for better fares.
Check museum opening days and hours before you go, since many close one day a week.
Plan a short local bus or rideshare from the station to the lakefront.

trips.route_note: Take the South Shore Line commuter train from Millennium Station in Chicago directly to Michigan City, about 1.5 hours, then use a taxi or rideshare to reach the Indiana Dunes beaches and trails.
see: Dune trails such as Mount Baldy
Washington Park Beach and Michigan City lakefront
trips.tour_query: Indiana Dunes day trip from Chicago
trips.why: The South Shore Line runs direct from downtown Chicago in about 1h 22m, but you will need a taxi or rideshare to reach the dunes and trails.
know: Weekend South Shore service can be less frequent than weekday service, so check the timetable.
The dune sights are spread across several areas, so a taxi or rideshare will make the most of your time there.
